question: In Hepatocellular trials, interpret the PD-L1 requirement flag as boolean true/false.

steps.desc: Filter Hepatocellular trials and select PD-L1 positivity inclusion criteria.
Map free text to boolean true/false.
steps.prompt: For each row, read "Is PD-L1 positivity inclusion criteria" and emit JSON {NCT, PMID, pdl1_required} with boolean value. If the text indicates PD-L1 positivity is an inclusion criteria, output true. If the text indicates PD-L1 positivity is not an inclusion criteria, output false. If the text is unclear or missing, output null. Output JSON objects only—one per input row; no prose.

steps.desc: Coerce to booleans; drop invalid rows.
